segments.text:
V. 48.
All Men will believe—And receive Him as the Meſſiah. And this will give ſuch Umbrage to the Ronans that they will come and ſubvert both our place—Temple; and nation—Both our Church and State. Where they really afraid of this? Or was it a fair Colour only? Certainly it was no more. For they could not but know, that He that raiſed the Dead, was able to conquer the Romans.
